extra.reason: Builds in GitLab CI; test screen and UART0 banner verified on hardware.
UART0 IRQ ring buffer + teletype (CR/LF/BS/TAB, deferred wrap, scrolling, blinking cursor, status line) verified on hardware.
Root-caused: flash SCK over spec at 270 MHz; COPY_TO_RAM is the default.
Verified on hardware: 800x600 demo at 80 and 132 columns, line drawing joins. Cursor invisible on blank cells in terminal mode is tracked separately.

VT100 parser and emulation implemented and host-tested; checked with vttest on hardware. Findings split out: DECSCNM/underline/blink (dmt.4), double width/height (dmt.12/13, deferred), smooth scroll (dmt.14, deferred), alternate screen (dmt.15), VT52 (dmt.16). REP added.
Verified on hardware: cursor visible and blinking on blank cells in terminal mode.

Verified on hardware: DECSCNM light/dark background, underline, blink and emboldened bold. RTS/CTS flow control implemented (hardware UART0 on GP3/GP2) but off by default per user; README documents enabling it.
Verified on hardware (Pico 2 + DVI Sock) by the user.
Fixed on branch usb-keyboard: screen_resets counter, main redraws status on change
Done for RP2350: TinyUSB host keyboard verified by the user on Pico 2 + DVI Sock (typing, bidirectional serial). RP2040 Feather crashed with it; USB_KEYBOARD defaults OFF there, follow-up in dmt.20.

Not viable: 800x600 runs clk_sys at 400 MHz, not a multiple of 12 MHz as Pico-PIO-USB needs, and it would cost more CPU/RAM than the native controller on the RP2040 that already failed (dmt.20). The native-port keyboard (dmt.5) covers RP2350.
Verified by the user on hardware: logo shows after monitor sync (10 s default, LOGO_MS), ends early on UART byte or key, terminal starts cleanly. Demo is opt-in (STARTUP_DEMO=OFF).
Implemented (src/nvflash.[ch], settings.[ch]); verified on the Pico 2 (RP2350): settings save at 400 MHz and persist. RP2040 path built and host-tested only, see follow-up.
F12/Pause or CSI ? 999 ~ opens SET-UP; power-on 80/132 saved in flash. Verified on the Pico 2.
DECBKM (CSI ? 67 h/l) with a SET-UP power-on default, restored by RIS.
Status line shows the last key sent and local echo; Local echo SET-UP setting.
Logo data kept in flash (LOGO_IN_FLASH); verified loading on both the Pico 2 and the Feather RP2040.

SET-UP complete: columns, Backspace, local echo, baud, framing, LNM, Colors (white/green/amber/blue phosphor; status line, panel and logo follow), Palette color/mono, colour preview. Verified on hardware. Flow control split to dmt.27, ADM-3A to dmt.28.
